title: Core purse and ammo slots: coins auto-convert into coin slots; wallet spans coin slots and backpack; ammo slots used first
player_outcome: Picked-up coins fly into the coin slots, and 100 copper becomes 1 silver on its own. Shops, the Nurse, reforging and death penalties see money in any slot. Arrows and bullets go to the ammo slots and are fired from there first. The bow's hotbar slot will show the arrows left (drawn in P2-12).
design:
PlayerInventory.Pickup routing:
- Coin items (tag 'coin'): merge into Coins, then fill empty Coins slots, then call `Coins.Normalize(this, content)`. Any remainder goes to the backpack.
- Items with AmmoClass: merge into matching Ammo stacks, then empty Ammo slots, then the backpack.
- Everything else: backpack.
- Pickup needs content for Normalize, so PlayerInventory gets a `ContentDatabase? Content` set by PlayerState.CreateNew/ToState, or Normalize becomes a method on a helper taking content. Pick the first to keep Pickup's call sites unchanged.

Coins.Normalize(PlayerInventory, ContentDatabase): sums the Coins inventory, clears it, and re-gives the largest denominations into Coins. Overflow goes to the backpack. Add `Coins.Total(PlayerInventory)` = Coins plus Backpack.

Wallet overloads `TrySpend(PlayerInventory, content, copper, out overflow)` and `Give(PlayerInventory, content, copper)`: take from Coins and Backpack coins, and return change to Coins first. Then update every caller:
- TownCommerce.Buy, Sell and Heal (TownCommerce.cs:119,137,159).
- TownServices reforge, taxes and angler (TownServices.cs:51,82,111).
- GameWorld.Death.cs Classic half-coin drop.
- TownSystem.cs:139 PlayerCoins.
- The InventoryScreen and TownDialog coin labels (temporary until P2-15).

Ammo lookup: `PlayerInventory.FindAmmo(string ammoClass)` returns `(Inventory Inv, int Slot)?`, searching Ammo 0..3 then the backpack. `CountAmmo(string ammoClass)` feeds the hotbar count. ItemUseSystem.Shoot (ItemUseSystem.cs:326-331) uses it; this is a 3-line change, and the static FindAmmo(Inventory, …) stays for existing tests.
Update test helpers that read Coins.Total(Backpack) to use Coins.Total(PlayerInventory): TownServicesTests.Purse, TownTests.Purse, CharacterTests, ArsenalTests.
files_modify: game/UI/InventoryScreen.cs, game/UI/TownDialog.cs — coin labels read the purse (temporary)
